fieldNotes.displayTitle: Normalized UI/activity title; not claimed to be the official lesson title.
fieldNotes.textbookTitle: Official lesson title copied from the visible table of contents when the course can be mapped; an array means more than one related lesson and is deliberately not collapsed into a single guessed lesson.
fieldNotes.chapter: Official chapter label from the table of contents; an array means the activity crosses chapters.
fieldNotes.lesson: Official lesson label from the table of contents; an array means multiple related lessons.
fieldNotes.page: Lesson start page from the table of contents, not an asserted page for the exact experiment. pdf is the physical PDF page index and printed is the page number printed in the book. null means no safe page mapping.
fieldNotes.confidence: high = direct lesson/topic alignment and visible table-of-contents evidence; medium = related lesson(s) but not a one-to-one lesson; low = only a topic relation or a candidate source; unverified = no safe Hóa 11/12 mapping.
fieldNotes.noGuessing: A missing Hóa 10 source or an activity absent from the Hóa 11/12 table of contents is left unmapped rather than inferred.
